## Outcome: partial and stalled
The unrestricted characteristic-zero Macaulay quartic thickening question remains unresolved. This PR preserves restricted exclusions: no binomial thickening, no thickening containing the reduced quadric, and no homogeneous thickening of generic multiplicity one or two. Higher transverse/nonhomogeneous possibilities remain open.

## Independent adversarial review
A separate reviewer checked the precise source scope, all restricted arguments, the 135-assertion author verifier, and six independent exact check groups before this PR. Full report and reproducible checks are included. The mathematical snapshot is unchanged from the reviewed commit; its original pending-review header is preserved and superseded by README/status/review records.

Four of five substantive attempts used; stopped after concrete obstructions rather than claiming a full solution. No novelty or human-peer-review claim. Only the isolated problem folder is included; the queue row will be updated to partial.
title: 30000224: reviewed partial obstructions; original problem remains open
